# Visium HD Visualiations
```{r}
counts = Read10X(data.dir = "/data/gpfs/projects/punim0614/ashtonl/FlexiDeconv/Visium_HD/Data/Visium_Data/spaceranger/binned_outputs/square_008um/filtered_feature_bc_matrix")
positions = read_parquet("/data/gpfs/projects/punim0614/ashtonl/FlexiDeconv/Visium_HD/Data/Visium_Data/spaceranger/binned_outputs/square_008um/spatial/tissue_positions.parquet")
scale_factors = fromJSON("/data/gpfs/projects/punim0614/ashtonl/FlexiDeconv/Visium_HD/Data/Visium_Data/spaceranger/binned_outputs/square_008um/spatial/scalefactors_json.json")
```

```{r}
positions = positions[positions$in_tissue == 1, ]
shared_barcodes = intersect(colnames(counts), positions$barcode)
counts = counts[, shared_barcodes]
positions = positions[match(shared_barcodes, positions$barcode), ]

nUMI = colSums(counts)
plot_df = data.frame(
  x = positions$pxl_col_in_fullres,
  y = positions$pxl_row_in_fullres,
  nUMI = nUMI
)
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = log10(nUMI + 1))) + geom_point(size = 0.1)+ scale_colour_viridis_c() +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Visium HD 8µm bins — log10(nUMI)",
    colour = "log10(nUMI + 1)"
  )
```

# QC in preparation for Loading
```{r}
# Counts per-bin
qc =  data.frame(
    barcode         = colnames(counts),
    total_counts    = Matrix::colSums(counts),
    n_genes         = Matrix::colSums(counts > 0),
    row.names       = colnames(counts)
)

# Counts per-gene
gene_qc <- data.frame(
    gene            = rownames(counts),
    total_counts    = Matrix::rowSums(counts),
    n_bins          = Matrix::rowSums(counts > 0),
    row.names       = rownames(counts)
)

qc = merge(qc, positions, by = "barcode", all.x = TRUE)
rownames(qc) = qc$Row.names
head(qc)
```
Metric 1: Total UMI count per bin
```{r}
median(qc$total_counts)
boxplot(qc$total_counts, horizontal = TRUE)
summary(qc$total_counts)
```


```{r}
# Plot 1: Raw UMI counts
p1_raw <- ggplot(qc, aes(x = total_counts)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 100, fill = "steelblue", colour = "white") +
    labs(
        title = "Total UMI counts per 8µm bin",
        subtitle = "Raw scale",
        x = "UMI count",
        y = "Number of bins"
    ) +
    theme_classic()

# Plot 2: log10(UMI + 1) transformed
p1_log <- ggplot(qc, aes(x = log10(total_counts + 1))) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 100, fill = "steelblue", colour = "white") +
    labs(
        title = "Total UMI counts per 8µm bin",
        subtitle = "log10(UMI + 1) scale",
        x = "log10(UMI + 1)",
        y = "Number of bins"
    ) +
    theme_classic()

# Display side by side
p1_raw | p1_log
```
Metric 2: Number of Genes detected per bin:
```{r}
p2 <- ggplot(qc, aes(x = n_genes)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 100, fill = "darkorange", colour = "white") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 50, colour = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(
        title = "Genes detected per 8µm bin",
        x = "Number of genes detected",
        y = "Number of bins"
    ) +
    theme_classic()
p2

set.seed(1)
qc_sample <- qc[sample(nrow(qc), min(50000, nrow(qc))), ]

p3_heatmap <- ggplot(qc_sample, aes(x = log10(total_counts + 1), y = n_genes)) +
    geom_bin2d(bins = 80) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
        option = "magma",
        trans  = "log10",
        name   = "log10(bins)"
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
        method    = "loess",
        colour    = "cyan",
        linewidth = 0.8,
        se        = FALSE       # drop confidence ribbon to speed rendering
    ) +
    labs(
        title    = "UMI counts vs. genes detected per 8µm bin",
        subtitle = paste0("Downsampled to ", nrow(qc_sample), " bins for visualisation"),
        x        = "log10(UMI + 1)",
        y        = "Genes detected"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")

p3_heatmap
```
Metric 3: Spatial Distribution of QC Metrics
```{r}
# Spatial UMI plot
p6_spatial_umi <- ggplot(qc, aes(
        x      = pxl_col_in_fullres,
        y      = -pxl_row_in_fullres,
        colour = log10(total_counts + 1)
    )) +
    geom_point(size = 0.05) +
    scale_colour_viridis_c(
        option = "magma",
        name   = "log10(UMI+1)"
    ) +
    labs(
        title = "Spatial distribution of UMI counts",
        x     = NULL,
        y     = NULL
    ) +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")

# Spatial genes detected plot
p7_spatial_genes <- ggplot(qc, aes(
        x      = pxl_col_in_fullres,
        y      = -pxl_row_in_fullres,
        colour = n_genes
    )) +
    geom_point(size = 0.05) +
    scale_colour_viridis_c(
        option = "inferno",
        name   = "Genes detected"
    ) +
    labs(
        title = "Spatial distribution of genes detected",
        x     = NULL,
        y     = NULL
    ) +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")

p6_spatial_umi | p7_spatial_genes
```

Metric 4: Spatial Distribution of Bins Passing candidate thresholds:
```{r}
# Apply candidate thresholds
min_counts <- 75
min_genes  <- 50

qc$passes_qc <- qc$total_counts >= min_counts & qc$n_genes >= min_genes

p8_spatial_qc <- ggplot(qc, aes(
        x      = pxl_col_in_fullres,
        y      = -pxl_row_in_fullres,
        colour = passes_qc
    )) +
    geom_point(size = 0.05) +
    scale_colour_manual(
        values = c("TRUE" = "grey70", "FALSE" = "red"),
        name   = "Passes QC",
        labels = c("TRUE" = "Pass", "FALSE" = "Fail")
    ) +
    labs(
        title    = "Bins passing QC thresholds",
        subtitle = paste0(
            "min UMI = ", min_counts,
            ", min genes = ", min_genes,
            " | Passing: ",
            round(mean(qc$passes_qc) * 100, 1), "%"
        ),
        x = NULL,
        y = NULL
    ) +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")

p8_spatial_qc
```
